title: Thermal array occupancy sensing with background subtraction
abstract: A thermal array occupancy sensor subtracts a stored background frame and adapts it during low activity.
description: A ceiling thermal array sensor stores a background frame at installation. During periods of low activity, the background frame is updated as a running average of recent frames. A pixel is marked occupied when its reading exceeds the background by a threshold derived from that pixel's noise.

claims.text: A method of detecting occupancy, comprising: storing a background frame from a thermal array; updating the background frame during periods of low activity; and marking a pixel occupied when its reading exceeds the background frame by a fixed temperature offset.
The method of claim 1, wherein the fixed temperature offset is 0.5 degrees Celsius.
